meaning_en: To become less strong or intense; decrease.
sentence: The rain began to abate by evening.

meaning_en: Kind, generous and wanting to help others.
sentence: The benevolent old man donated his savings to build a school.

meaning_en: Honest and frank, even when the truth is unpleasant.
sentence: She gave a candid opinion about my essay.

meaning_en: A complete failure or collapse.

meaning_en: Able to speak or write in a fluent and persuasive way.
sentence: The eloquent speaker moved the entire audience to tears.

meaning_en: Careful with money; avoiding waste.
sentence: He leads a frugal life and saves most of his salary.

meaning_en: Enjoying the company of other people; sociable.
sentence: Gregarious people usually enjoy parties and group activities.

meaning_en: Behaving as if one is better than others; arrogant.
sentence: The haughty manager ignored the junior staff.

meaning_en: Without any fault or flaw; perfect.
sentence: Her manners at the dinner were impeccable.

meaning_en: Feeling or showing great joy, especially after a success.
sentence: The team was jubilant after winning the cup.

meaning_en: To cause a feeling or interest to begin; to set fire to.
sentence: The speech kindled an interest in science among the students.

meaning_en: Feeling tired, slow and without energy.
sentence: The summer heat made everyone feel lethargic.

meaning_en: Very careful and precise about small details.

meaning_en: Lacking experience or judgement; too trusting.
sentence: It was naive of him to trust a stranger with all his money.

meaning_en: No longer used because something newer has replaced it.

meaning_en: Dealing with problems in a practical, realistic way.
sentence: We need a pragmatic solution to the budget problem.

meaning_en: Complaining in a whining or irritable way.
sentence: The querulous child grumbled all through the journey.

meaning_en: Able to recover quickly from difficulties.
sentence: Children are often more resilient than adults expect.

meaning_en: Having or showing wisdom and good judgement.

meaning_en: Holding firmly to a purpose; very persistent.

meaning_en: Present or found everywhere.

meaning_en: To prove that someone was right or not guilty.

meaning_en: Cautious about possible danger or deception.

meaning_en: Dislike or fear of people from other countries.

meaning_en: Full of energy and eagerness for a cause.
